subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should this issue continue as the canonical tracker for the remaining announce/live-session Claude CLI restart work, or should maintainers reopen or create a narrower canonical follow-up now that groupIntro and binding hard-invalidation are fixed on main?
rationale: The original title trigger is largely fixed on main, but closed duplicates and the latest stable-release comments still route broader announce/live-fingerprint symptoms here; only maintainers can choose whether to keep this broader canonical scope or split it cleanly.

options.title: Keep Broad Canonical Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until the announce/live-session fingerprint path is fixed or explicitly moved to a new canonical issue.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Open or reopen a narrower announce/live-session issue, link this history there, then close this issue as implemented for the groupIntro and binding-hard-invalidation axes.

options.title: Close After Sibling PRs
options.body: Close only after the open live-fingerprint and groupIntro PRs are resolved, accepting that some announce symmetry may still need follow-up review.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the announce/live-session fingerprint path is fixed or explicitly moved to a new canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged fixes in the exact CLI session reuse and group prompt identity boundary and are best positioned to scope what remains.
